feedback.answered: Replication workers capture the tenure-specific commitment and stepDown channel; delayed work does not target a later tenure through these fields. Startup reconstructs term, log and snapshot context and scans later configurations. InstallSnapshot waits for serialized FSM restore before adopting snapshot/configuration metadata. Configuration validation enforces unique identities/addresses and at least one voter; current AddVoter directly makes a voter. FSM completion and dispatched lastApplied are distinct. These findings replace the prior backbone reading gaps in the new map. A separate verification surface is now sourced: all workers receive verification futures while the threshold counts voters, and vote() has no participant eligibility argument.
